ingredients: 1/2 tsp each: garlic powder, onion powder,
steps: Dice 1120g (40oz) chicken breast into bite-sized cubes. In a bowl, combine with 70g (5 Tbsp) soy sauce, 50g (3 Tbsp) sriracha, 20g (4 tsp) lime juice, and 1⁄2 tsp garlic powder, 1⁄2 tsp onion powder, and 1⁄2 tsp red chili flakes. Marinate for at least 20-30 minutes.

In a separate bowl, whisk together 200g (~3⁄4 cup) peanut butter, 80g (5 Tbsp) soy sauce, 40g (3 Tbsp) sriracha, 150g (7 1⁄2 Tbsp) honey, 80g (1/2 cup) chopped sun-dried tomatoes, and 90g (6 Tbsp) lime juice until smooth. Set aside.
Boil 600g (22oz) noodles of choice according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.

In a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat, cook the marinated chicken for 4-5 minutes. Add 20 cloves minced garlic and the whites of 10 green onions, and cook for another 2-3 minutes until fragrant and chicken is fully cooked. Remove and set aside.

Reduce heat to low. In the same pan, add the peanut sauce and 160g (2/3 cup) water. Stir to thin slightly. Add cooked noodles and toss everything in the sauce. Simmer for 2-3 minutes to absorb flavor. Return cooked chicken to the pan and toss.
Garnish with the green parts of the green onions before serving. Enjoy, and freeze leftovers.
